description:
In Stage 2? Here’s your next step: https://bit.ly/020-25


In this video, I break down the 4 stages of growth that guide all of my content going forward. Each stage needs a different approach — and knowing where you are helps you get the most out of my advice. Watch this to understand how my videos fit into your journey.


01:24 - Stage 1
02:34 - Stage 2
04:21 - Stage 3
06:58 - Stage 4
08:20 - What do you do with this?
